commit.message:
Emit spec-valid OpenAPI format for DecimalField (#974)

The DecimalField mapping used format 'decimal', which is not a valid
OpenAPI type format (the spec only defines 'float' and 'double' for
numbers). When a DecimalField is rendered as a number (decimal_as_float),
emit 'double'; when it is rendered as a string (the default), omit the
numeric format entirely. The same fix is applied to the Decimal type hint
used by SerializerMethodField.

Updates the reference schema snapshot and adds tests covering both the
string and number cases.

Co-authored-by: Chris (ChrisJr404) <11917633+ChrisJr404@users.noreply.github.com>

commit.message:
Use Python's native `dict` instead of `OrderedDict` (#954)

* fix Python 3.12 type parameter syntax with ``from __future__ import annotations``

This change fixes Python 3.12 type parameter syntax (PEP-695) used with
postponed evaluation of annotations (PEP-563).

* use Python's native `dict` instead of `OrderedDict`

Python's native `dict` preserves insertion order and `OrderedDict` is no
longer needed. The "sane" YAML loaders and dumpers have been updated and
also renamed to just `Yaml{Dumper,Loader}` as the word "sane" is not
helpful and they are just the default YAML format this library prefers.

---------

Co-authored-by: Joel Lefkowitz <joellefkowitz@hotmail.com>

commit.message:
Update logout button to use POST request. (#945)

Presumably, most users use a LOGOUT_URL that maps to Django's LogoutView.
However, using GET with LogoutView has been deprecated since Django 4.1.
We update the logout button to use POST instead.

Fixes #733.

See: https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/dev/releases/4.1/#log-out-via-get
